entries.name: Extended Great Deluge
entries.formula: Accept every improving candidate in addition to candidates satisfying the water-level bound; the time-predefined formulation interprets its controls through search time and expected final quality.
entries.publication: Burke, Bykov, Newall & Petrovic (2003), A Time-Predefined Approach to Course Timetabling

entries.name: Adaptive Flex-Deluge
entries.formula: Flexible Great-Deluge acceptance with run-time adaptation of the acceptance condition, scientifically distinct from the classical one-parameter Dueck water-level controller.
entries.publication: Burke & Bykov (2016), An Adaptive Flex-Deluge Approach to University Exam Timetabling
